column1: # CI checks. starter is the default for everyone, on the site and in the CLI; a plan can turn r-cmd-check-extended off
# (lists/plans.tsv). events: pr, push, schedule, manual, comma separated; a check with schedule runs weekly. cron: an
# odd minute, because GitHub delays scheduled runs at round hours; empty for a check that never runs on a schedule.
# platforms is empty for Linux-only checks. test_kinds: the kinds of test file the check runs (plain, browser, snap,
# extended; see tests/README.md). label goes in the workflows README; help is the site's longer tip.

column3: R CMD check, the core check
column11: R CMD check, the core check. It runs on every pull request and push, and weekly.

column11: Checks style, that the docs are in sync, and spelling.

column11: Measures how much of your code the tests run.

column3: Run every test, including the browser, snapshot and extended tests CRAN skips, with Chrome for browser tests
column11: Runs every test, including the ones CRAN skips: test files ending in -browser, -snap or -extended. Runs on Linux.

column3: Run R CMD check on more systems, with the extended tests
column11: Every week, R CMD check on more systems, with the test files ending in -extended. A public package gets Mac and Windows; a private one gets Linux only.
